comments.author: _HAVOC_
comments.body_html:
That’s a really good idea. It’s a real shame you can’t create a new item that the player has to equip in a special slot. A speedloader as an item would be awesome. What do you think about contacting some modders to see if they could create a corresponding 3D model for you? A multitool is a multitool and not a speedloader :-( Without an equipped speedloader, this mod is unfortunately just an ammo loader “buff.”

If you can’t create a 3D model, you can also use existing items from the game, “clone” them, and optionally apply a new texture and change the corresponding properties.

There are three suitable small items in the game:

  • Rechargeable Battery or Mark of the Unheard or MS2000 Marker

If you do manage to create a 3D model, you should

  • unlock it via a difficult three-part quest that also involves the idea of ​​a speedloader, or receive it as a reward (perhaps because there are few speedloaders in Tarkov, and the mechanic needs one as a prototype. You’re supposed to find this prototype and also gather the necessary materials).
